endpoint.name: eoRequestExport
endpoint.description: XML-instruction based integration API used to request Paper Out / Export of a transaction, document, or group thereof, with an optional mediaType element (PrintToPaper | SaveAsElectronicFile).
endpoint.urlOrMethod: UNKNOWN -- not discoverable through this session's tools
endpoint.architecturalNote: Confirmed this session to live entirely outside the ssweb browser application that Playwright MCP drives against qa5. It has zero references anywhere in reports/validation/ecore-api-discovery.json (the browser-app endpoint inventory), and real Jira dev-team evidence (EC-12000 comments) shows it is exercised via Postman, not the browser UI. Browser-network-trace capture via Playwright MCP is therefore the wrong tool for this contract; a human must supply the integration endpoint's base URL/credentials or an existing WSDL/integration-guide reference.

requestContract.provenance: Real, versioned, publicly-hosted XSD referenced by xsi:schemaLocation in three real dev-tested sample XML attachments on the EC-12000 Jira issue. Fetched and saved verbatim this session (not authored/guessed).

fields.mediaType: enum [PrintToPaper, SaveAsElectronicFile], optional -- confirms AC-EC-12000-005/-006's optionality and back-compat

exactlyOneOf: transaction (repeatable; attributes id [long, required], deleteIfEmpty [boolean, default true]; contains retentionPolicy OR document)
document (repeatable; attributes id [long, required], retain [asIs|eCopy|none, required])
requestContract.realFailureModeObserved: Jira comment (POD issue 103974) documents org.mybatis.spring.MyBatisSystemException / Invalid column type: 1111 when mediaType is omitted on a pre-26.3 release -- corroborates AC-EC-12000-005/-006's release-gating, not fabricated.

responseContract.reason: The only response evidence in Jira is a screenshot image (not transcribed text) of a Postman response; no response body, status code, or success/error shape was captured as text. Not guessed here per AGENTS.md.

scenarios.summary: API mediaType=PrintToPaper at transaction level determines Media Type Paper, confirmed via UI audit trail.
scenarios.blockedReason: eoRequestExport endpoint/response unverified (see endpoint.urlOrMethod and responseContract above); also depends on the same audit-trail access needed for TS-016, itself blocked on the data-fixture gap (see TP-EC-12000-001-browser-validation.json openBlockers).

scenarios.summary: API mediaType=SaveAsElectronicFile at transaction level determines Media Type Electronic, confirmed via UI audit trail.
API mediaType omitted at transaction level determines Media Type Electronic (default), confirmed via UI audit trail.
API mediaType=PrintToPaper at document level determines Media Type Paper, confirmed via UI audit trail.
API mediaType=SaveAsElectronicFile at document level determines Media Type Electronic, confirmed via UI audit trail.

openBlockers.description: eoRequestExport's request shape is now schema-backed (real, versioned export.xsd plus 3 real dev-tested sample XMLs), but its endpoint URL/HTTP method and response shape remain unknown. It is confirmed to live entirely outside the ssweb browser app (Postman-only in dev usage, absent from ecore-api-discovery.json), so Playwright MCP cannot observe it.
openBlockers.recommendedResolution: A human supplies the integration endpoint's base URL/credentials (or the team's existing WSDL/integration-guide reference) so a real request/response pair can be captured outside the browser -- e.g. directly from an EoRequestExportClient in src/api/ per AGENTS.md's API-client layering -- and promoted to HUMAN_APPROVED with a responseShapeHash once a human confirms it judges the acceptance criteria.
